ceu: ✦ The trine between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.
